name: Medical Bed
description: You can get in and out of the medical bed by interacting with it using [$[action_use_seat]]. You can place a rescued survivor in any medical bed by using [$[action_use_seat]] while carrying them.
shortDescription: A bed equiped with medical monitoring equipment, slowly heals injured characters.

logicNodes.label: Occupied
logicNodes.description: Outputs an on signal if this bed is occupied by a character.
